$comment: Prompts for tools/generate-sfx.mjs (ElevenLabs Sound Effects). Each kind has a length in seconds (20 credits a second) and may set how closely the sound follows the prompt (influence, 0–1, 0.5 when left out); an approved draft goes to src/client/audio/sfx/<id>.mp3 and into data/sounds.json. A kind with tts is speech (ElevenLabs text to speech): each prompt names a voice and a text or a card of data/tutorial.json; it costs creditsPerCharacter for each character, and an approved recording goes to src/client/audio/narration/<card>.mp3 and into data/tutorial.json (voice).

wolf-hurt.text: a wolf snarls in pain when hit, a short fierce growl through bared teeth, not a yelp, video game creature hurt sound, close up, dry, no music

prompts.wolf-death: a wolf whimpers and collapses, dying whine, close up, dry, no music

alpha-wolf-hurt.text: a single short deep snarling yelp of a huge wolf hit by a blow, quick and fierce, video game creature hurt sound, close up, dry, no music

prompts.alpha-wolf-death: a huge wolf lets out a long dying howl that fades, close up, dry, no music
prompts.fox-hurt: a fox gives a sharp high yelp of pain, close up, dry, no music
prompts.fox-death: a fox whimpers weakly and falls silent, close up, dry, no music

prompts.lynx-death: a big wild cat gives a dying growl, close up, dry, no music
prompts.bear-hurt: a brown bear roars in pain from a hit, short deep roar, close up, dry, no music
prompts.bear-death: a brown bear groans deeply and collapses heavily, close up, dry, no music
